sections.Profile:
"Thunderball" is a pinball machine from Williams, released in May 1982 but was never mass-produced, with only 10 units made. It features a solid-state design with two flippers, one ramp, and a six-ball multiball feature. The game was part of the Williams System 7 series and has become a rare collector's item due to its limited production.
